About HPHT/CVD

1. HPHT stands for high pressure high temperature. This method recreates the heat and pressure conditions that form diamond crystals by using controlled equipment, seed crystals, and carbon sources to grow lab diamonds.

2. CVD stands for chemical vapor deposition. In this process, carbon-rich gas is heated in a pressure chamber, allowing carbon layers to build on a substrate until a rough diamond forms and is later cut into a gemstone.
